summary: The customer called Metro Utilities threatening a shut-off because his power was due to be disconnected today, demanding a payment extension. The agent verified his account, found an existing extension from last quarter which blocked a new automated extension, and offered to transfer him to a supervisor upon request.

evidence.text: I can certainly transfer you to a supervisor to discuss further options, Mr. Davis. Please hold while I connect you.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Transfer the customer to a supervisor to discuss further payment options.

evidence.text: I understand you are concerned about your service, and I'd be happy to check your account for extension options.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm, polite, and professional demeanor throughout the call despite the customer's frustration.

evidence.text: I understand you are concerned about your service, and I'd be happy to check your account for extension options.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's concern and offered reassurance right at the start.

evidence.text: I can certainly transfer you to a supervisor to discuss further options, Mr. Davis. Please hold while I connect you.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent could not grant the extension due to system limits, but effectively handled the escalation request by offering a supervisor transfer.

evidence.text: I do show that an extension was already granted on this account last quarter, which unfortunately prevents the system from automatically applying another one.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained clearly and concisely why the system could not grant another extension.

evidence.text: Please hold while I connect you.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended abruptly with a warm transfer instead of a standard wrap-up, though appropriate for the escalation.

evidence.text: Thank you, Mr. Davis. I see your current balance of two hundred and forty dollars was due last week.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately retrieved and reported the account balance, due date, and previous extension history.

evidence.text: May I have your account number and name, please?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly verified the customer's identity and account information before discussing account details.

quote.text: I am calling because my power is about to be shut off today, and this is completely ridiculous! I need an extension right now!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: And don't just tell me no, because I've been a customer for ten years and I've never missed a payment until this month!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I don't need you to look, I need you to grant it! I get paid next Friday, and I am not sitting in the dark with my kids because of a few days!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Are you kidding me? You're going to shut off my electricity over a policy when I'm telling you I can pay next week? Let me talk to your manager immediately!
quote.speaker: Customer
